In my role as the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment, I strive to fulfill the solemn responsibility and unique opportunity to modernize how the Department delivers capability, faster, smarter, and in a collaborative partnership with American industry. My top priorities are clear: deliver capability at speed and scale, rebuild a more resilient defense industrial base, reform outdated processes, and empower our acquisition workforce to operate with agility and confidence. ...
